mapper.select: SELECT /* selectEmployeeById / 샘플 단건조회 */ emp_id AS empId, name, department, salary, hire_date AS hireDate FROM sample WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
SELECT /* selectAllEmployees / 샘플 다건조회 */ emp_id AS empId, name, department, salary, hire_date AS hireDate FROM sample ORDER BY emp_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sample /* updateEmployee / 샘플 수정 */ SET name = #{name}, department = #{department}, salary = #{salary}, hire_date = #{hireDate} WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sample /* deleteEmployee / 샘플 삭제 */ WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
